Key Accountabilities

Key Area

Main Activity

KPI

(Key Performance Indicator)

Contract and Transaction Support

Handle pre and post contract activities which include drafting, reviewing, negotiating and supporting the implementation of agreements, correspondence, contractual claims and other related documents. The primary scope includes sourcing, procurement, vendor/supply, network and interconnection, IT and technology, lease/property, and other business enablement or operational matters. The role may also support other transactions or legal matters assigned from time to time, taking into account business needs, workload allocation and changes to the Company’s organization or operating model.

Turnaround: The extent to which User(s) receive all forms of legal counsel within a reasonable timeframe (measured on a scale of 1-5).

Results: The extent to which planned results are attained by legal counsel (measured on a scale of 1-5).

Overall satisfaction: The extent to which User(s) are satisfied with legal services provided by legal counsel (measured on a scale of 1-5).

Collaboration: Effectiveness in collaborating with members of the directorate and other relevant functions (measured on a scale of 1–5).

Contractual Compliance and Risk Management

Identify and advise on legal and contractual risks and help ensure that relevant agreements and transactions comply with applicable laws, regulations and internal policies, including those relating to procurement, telecommunications and network infrastructure, IT and data governance, lease/property, and vendor arrangements. Support the implementation of appropriate contractual safeguards, internal approvals and risk-mitigation measures.

Turnaround: The extent to which User(s) receive all forms of legal counsel within a reasonable timeframe (measured on a scale of 1-5).

Results: The extent to which planned results are attained by legal counsel (measured on a scale of 1-5).

Legal Advisory and Business Support

Keep abreast of laws and regulations development and changes relevant to procurement, network/interconnection, IT/technology, and lease/property matters, and conduct legal research on matters which may affect the company’s business and operations activities.

Provide day-to-day legal advice and practical support in relation to the negotiation, execution, implementation, management and enforcement of contracts and arrangements within the role’s assigned scope. Coordinate with relevant internal stakeholders and, where required, external legal counsel or other professional advisers..

Turnaround: The extent to which User(s) receive all forms of legal counsel within a reasonable timeframe (measured on a scale of 1-5).

Results: The extent to which planned results are attained by legal counsel (measured on a scale of 1-5).

Overall satisfaction: The extent to which User(s) are satisfied with legal services provided by legal counsel (measured on a scale of 1-5).

Collaboration: Effectiveness in collaborating with members of the Legal Department and other relevant functions (measured on a scale of 1–5).

Requirements

Education

Min. bachelor’s degree in law (SH) from reputable universities in Indonesia.

Related Experienced

• Minimum 3–4 years of relevant experience in an in-house legal function or law firm, preferably involving the drafting, review and negotiation of sourcing, procurement, vendor/supply, network/infrastructure, IT/technology, lease/property or other commercial contracts.
• Good knowledge of Indonesian contract and commercial law and relevant regulatory requirements.
• Exposure to the telecommunications, data centre or technology infrastructure industry is an advantage.

Human Competency

• Strong analytical, drafting, negotiation, presentation and communication skills.
• Able to work independently and collaboratively, with a proactive, solutions-oriented and “can-do” attitude.
• Resourceful, conscientious, thorough and well-organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver assignments within the required timeline.
• Able to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders in a multicultural and changing organizational environment.
• Demonstrates sound judgment, integrity and appropriate escalation of material legal or contractual risks.

Generic Competency

• Fluency and proficieny in English and Indonesian language, MS Office (outlook, word, excel, ppt)
• Strong computer skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office products (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio).
• Familiarity with the use of AI/GenAI tools to support legal work (e.g., contract drafting/review assistance, legal research, document summarization) is an advantage.

Job Summary**

Responsible for supporting production and Warehouse Management System (WMS) operations at the RPU Megaluh facility, ensuring efficient data management, inventory accuracy, and smooth workflow.

Job Responsibilities**

* Perform daily data entry and verification related to production activities, including raw material consumption, finished goods production, and waste management.
* Monitor and maintain WMS data integrity, including stock movements, inventory adjustments, and location management.
* Generate various production and WMS reports as required, such as daily production summaries, inventory reports, and discrepancy reports.
* Assist in physical inventory counts and reconciliation with WMS records.
* Support troubleshooting of WMS-related issues and escalate complex problems to the appropriate personnel.
* Collaborate with production, warehousing, and logistics teams to ensure accurate and timely information flow.
* Maintain proper documentation and filing systems for all production and WMS-related records.
* Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and safety regulations.

Job Qualifications**

* Diploma (D3) or Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Information Technology, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven experience (1-2 years) in data entry, administration, or a similar role, preferably within a manufacturing or warehousing environment.
* Familiarity with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) is highly advantageous.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook).
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data handling.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to be placed in Megaluh, Jombang.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Operate production machinery and equipment, ensuring adherence to schedules and standards.
- Perform regular maintenance and repairs on equipment to ensure optimal performance.
- Identify and resolve production issues to minimize downtime.
- Ensure adherence to production schedules and standards, maintaining high levels of quality.
- Maintain a clean and safe work environment, following all safety protocols and regulations.
- Assist in the implementation of production improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
- Coordinate with other team members to ensure smooth production processes.

- Mengoperasikan mesin dan peralatan produksi, memastikan kepatuhan terhadap jadwal dan standar.
- Melakukan pemeliharaan dan perbaikan rutin pada peralatan untuk memastikan kinerja optimal.
- Mengidentifikasi dan memecahkan masalah produksi untuk meminimalkan waktu henti.
- Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap jadwal dan standar produksi, menjaga tingkat kualitas yang tinggi.
- Memelihara lingkungan kerja yang bersih dan aman, mengikuti semua protokol dan regulasi keselamatan.
- Mendukung implementasi perbaikan produksi untuk meningkatkan efisiensi dan mengurangi biaya.
- Berkoordinasi dengan anggota tim lain untuk memastikan proses produksi yang lancar.

Company:
DF PT. Dankos Farma
